title: FOUNDRY / INSTRUMENT GATEWAY
claim: A small public gateway over four unequal machine views: CORE / criteria, FIELD / address, MIGRATION / recovery evidence, CONFLUENCE / bounded transfer. No view becomes a duplicate database or runtime authority.
known_limits: The gateway is navigation/orientation, not runtime authority.
A linked donor is not thereby promoted to current head or canon.
CURRENT.json may change independently of this static route map.
Public recovery routes are scrubbed projections; private source/context may remain elsewhere.

receipt.change: Added a shared machine projection contract and compact cross-view rail; grounded the Core corpus claim; demoted unused SEED vocabulary to deprecated alias FRAME; made Confluence expose only explicit evidence-bounded transfer records.
receipt.next: Use the four views on normal work; add shared focus/handoff only after a real cross-view navigation failure is observed.

amendments.change: Added INTERPHASE / ROOM 0.1 as a bounded CANDIDATE projection: one FIELD route through six opposing relations with explicit door traversal, PLAIN comparator and RETURN. Also repaired the gateway's displayed AXIAL version to 0.7.3.

ROOM generation 2 replaces the six-face cube head with BLOCK ⇄ ROOM SPACE SCALE 0.2: typed seams, semantic operational zoom, reversible FOLD abstraction, subtree FORK, safe graph RUN, declarative RECIPE and RETURN. ROOM 0.1 is preserved as a reference probe.
